Different run shape — scope is that ONE sub-task PR.
fields.parent.key is read only to resolve <PARENT-BRANCH> (the PR's base)
via pr_base.sh --parent-key · the parent is never re-fetched as an acting issue ·
fields.subtasks is never read · no track is determined · the parent PR is never touched
walk: step 2 (this sub-task alone) → 3 → 6 → 7, then the run ends.
A full pass is a separate run from the parent's worktree — the rest of this diagram

source=env-default → proceed but flag it · unresolved → ask ·
a hotfix/ <PARENT-BRANCH> resolving to the staging base means the env

Step 1 — determine track from fields.subtasks
(empty → single-step · non-empty → multistep)
[multistep — fetch every sub-task's status]
both phase checks share two rules — several PRs back → act on the OPEN one
(several open → ask which) · a CLOSED, unmerged PR matches no enumerated state,
so stop and ask: someone abandoned this branch's PR deliberately, and both
opening a replacement and reviewing a dead one would guess at intent
<SELF> — this skill's GitHub identity — is resolved ONCE per run,
but only on the branches that actually review something. The four exits below that
review nothing (no PR yet · S-MERGED · M-FULLY-COMPLETE as detected by this phase check ·
nothing to review) never reach step 3 and never resolve it — 5a's second M-FULLY-COMPLETE
detector is the exception, reached through the step-3 loop with <SELF> already resolved.
Two branches DO review without entering step 3 — both every-sub-task-DONE splits below
(no parent PR → 5a+5b · open parent PR → 5b) — so 5b resolves <SELF> itself on each
executor hasn't opened a PR
single-step: the one PR is the whole set → review loop (step 3).
Step 2 is skipped — its PR set is the parent PR itself
gh missing or logged out → report the error and hand back the PR URLs
no Jira post in 3d on this track — 3d's destination and step 6's are
both <PARENT-KEY>, so step 6 is the single Jira record. Step 3e is skipped too

text.tspan: [Step 3 — per sub-task PR (In Review, sequential, one pass)]
Step 4 — all sub-task PRs visited
guard: "every PR in the set is merged" is NOT "the feature is complete".
The set only ever held sub-tasks that were <STATUS_IN_REVIEW> at step 1, so any
sub-task not yet <STATUS_DONE> — still in progress, or skipped by step 2 for having
no branch or no PR — stays on M-ALL-APPROVED and goes to step 6 instead.
Otherwise step 5 would open an aggregate PR missing the outstanding work
CONFLICTING → <PARENT-BRANCH> has fallen behind <BASE_BRANCH>.
Stop and report — a diff that cannot merge gives the user nothing to act on.
This is the only detector the "parent branch is behind its base" case has,
and it exits without a step-6 report
skip the re-review — nothing is posted to GitHub
a parent-PR reject transitions NO Jira issue —
unlike a sub-task reject, <PARENT-KEY> stays as it is

are still the work, so run the full step-2 pass and leave the parent PR to a later run
